description: This file defines a SwiftUI widget for the OpenClaw application, utilizing ActivityKit and WidgetKit to display a live activity with dynamic island support.

methods.name: lockScreenView
methods.description: Constructs the lock screen view for the activity, displaying status dot, activity name, status text, and trailing view.

methods.name: trailingView
methods.description: Generates a view showing the activity's current connection status or timer based on the state.

methods.name: statusDot
methods.description: Creates a small circle indicator whose color reflects the activity's current state.

methods.name: dotColor
methods.description: Determines the color of the status dot based on the activity's state.
